subject: Hypernova SLA verification & customer-led test coordination
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@hypernova.ai>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@hypernova.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Hypernova SLA verification & customer-led test coordination

Hi Sana / Tom —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on the SLA verification run you mentioned:

1) Targets we heard today (please confirm):
   - P95 latency target: <= 350ms for single-turn text generation (payload 64 tokens)
   - Sustained throughput: 600 requests/minute baseline; burst to 2,500 rpm for spikes
   - Streaming concurrency: up to 120 concurrent streams (avg TTL 30s)

2) What we need from Hypernova to run the customer-led stress window:
   - k6 or Locust scripts you intend to run (or a link to the repo/gist)
   - Test service accounts / API keys (scoped to test environment)
   - IP ranges to allowlist (we will add to our firewall and ingress rules)
   - Preferred test window(s) & timezone

3) Redwood deliverables before the window:
   - Temporary test account credentials and rate-limiting exemptions for the window
   - A short runbook listing endpoint paths, recommended headers (auth, x-customer-id), and guidance for streaming probes
   - Point-of-contact: Ben Carter (infra lead) for any on-call troubleshooting during the run

Can you share the k6 script link and a couple of candidate windows? We can then confirm the exact IPs and issue the test credentials.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@hypernova.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@hypernova.ai>, ops@hypernova.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hypernova SLA verification & customer-led test coordination

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirmation and items from our side:

- Targets: those are correct. We will be validating P95 and 99 during the run; if P99 exceeds 1.2s we will flag regressions but the acceptance gate is P95 <= 350ms.

- k6 script: linked here: https://github.com/hypernova/traffic-tests/blob/main/k6/hypernova-profile.js (we also attached a copy). It contains configs for normal and spike phases.

- Test credentials: we will create a service account with scoped API key (expires 2026-10-15) and share via secure link.

- IP allowlist: ops@hypernova.ai will send the CIDR blocks we will originate from. Expected ranges are 18.197.32.0/22 and 34.102.64.0/22 (final list attached).

- Proposed window: Thu Oct 8 10:00–14:00 PDT (4 hours) — this gives us time for baseline, 2 spike phases, and a short wrap. Alternate: Mon Oct 12 08:00–12:00 PDT. Please confirm which works for Redwood.

We will also add some sanity checks in the script for correct headers and token usage.

Thanks,
Sana
Sana Kapoor
Head of Platform Engineering | Hypernova Analytics
sana.kapoor@hypernova.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@hypernova.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hypernova SLA verification & customer-led test coordination

Sana — thanks for the quick turnaround and the k6 link. A few notes from the infra side before we lock the window:

- Auth: please ensure the script exchanges the service API key for a short-lived JWT on first request (we expect the Authorization: Bearer <jwt> header). If you want to run with static API keys we can allow that for the window but prefer the token flow to validate our cache behavior.

- Concurrency & sessions: for streaming probes set VUs to simulate 120 concurrent streams with randomized durations (avg 25–35s). For non-streaming endpoints run the baseline at 10 VUs ramping to 80 VUs; spike phase should mimic 2.5x request burst.

- Health probes: please include a light-weight /health check every 60s (not counted against SLA) so we can correlate infra events.

- IP allowlist: once we receive the final CIDRs we will provision firewall rules. To avoid accidental blocking, please provide a 1-hour pre-test connectivity window (we will open and test connectivity at least one hour prior).

- Logging & traces: we will enable extra sampling for the test window. If you can tag requests with x-hypernova-run: HN-374 and include x-test-run-id header, that will help us map traces back to your run.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-HN-374.xlsx (outline of responsibilities & timeline)

Marissa — confirm Thu Oct 8 10:00–14:00 PDT works for Redwood and I will be on-call during the run.

Ben Carter
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@hypernova.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@hypernova.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, ops@hypernova.ai
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hypernova SLA verification & customer-led test coordination

Ben / Marissa —

Thu Oct 8 10:00–14:00 PDT is confirmed on our side. Quick operational notes and links:

- We uploaded the k6 script (attached) and pushed a branch with a small change to include the x-test-run-id header: https://github.com/hypernova/traffic-tests/commit/5f6e7a

- Service account & API key: sharing secure link via our vault (ops@hypernova.ai will send separately). Key TTL set to 2026-10-15 as discussed.

- Final IP list attached (hypernova-ip-list.txt). We will originate from the two CIDR ranges Sana listed plus one additional transient range 35.198.128.0/22 for CDN egress during spikes.

- We'll join Redwood's connectivity check at 09:00 PDT on Thu Oct 8. Please confirm an endpoint and contact line for that check.

- We'll also produce a short results summary (latency histograms + error traces) within 2 hours after the window. If any gate fails (P95 > 350ms) we'll follow the rollback checklist in the mutual-action-plan.

Thanks — looking forward to the run.
Tom Ellis
Senior SRE | Hypernova Analytics
tom.ellis@hypernova.ai
